title: Run Cross Layer Analysis
description: Coordinate automated log analysis, stack traces, and hardware diagnostics to debug multi-chip hangs cross-layer.
instruction:
To perform a cross-layer multi-chip hang analysis:
1. Collect host-level and TPU runtime metrics alongside `libtpu` program launch/completion logs across all workers.
2. Inspect XLA compiler HLO dumps and collective communication schedules to identify the in-flight collective or barrier where the stall began.
3. Cross-reference host Python stack traces, `sflag` timeout directions (`SEND` vs `RECV`), and node hardware/termination events side by side to isolate the root-cause layer and culprit host.
